sql.if: AND (r.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR r.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR r.reviewer LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR r.platform_order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR r.seller_sku LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR r.platform_item_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.sql: r.id, r.store_id, r.platform, r.review_id, r.platform_item_id, r.seller_sku, r.listing_id, r.rating, r.title, r.content, r.reviewer, r.review_date, r.order_id, r.platform_order_no, r.replied, r.reply_content, r.reply_time, r.handle_status, r.handler_id, r.handle_note, r.source, r.create_time, r.update_time, s.name AS store_name, u.nickname AS handler_name, l.title AS listing_title
FROM ecom_review r JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = r.store_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.handler_id LEFT JOIN ecom_listing l ON l.id = r.listing_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.handle_status = 'PENDING' THEN 0 WHEN r.handle_status = 'PROCESSING' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, r.review_date DESC, r.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(r.rating), 0) AS ratingSum, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating <= #{low} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS lowCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.handle_status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.replied = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS repliedCount FROM ecom_review r

SELECT r.store_id AS storeId, s.name AS storeName, r.seller_sku AS sellerSku, MAX(l.title) AS title, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(r.rating) AS ratingSum, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating <= #{low} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lowCount, MAX(r.review_date) AS lastDate FROM ecom_review r JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = r.store_id LEFT JOIN ecom_listing l ON l.id = r.listing_id
GROUP BY r.store_id, s.name, r.seller_sku ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating <= #{low} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC, COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT r.review_date AS reviewDate, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(r.rating) AS ratingSum, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating <= #{low} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lowCount FROM ecom_review r
GROUP BY r.review_date ORDER BY r.review_date
